findings.title: Run totals omit earlier loop iterations
findings.description: The report reads only persisted `action_results`. Earlier loop iterations live in `StepResult.prior_rounds`, which `StateManager._append_step()` does not serialize. A verified two-round example costing $1 and $2 reports only $2. Persist every round’s usage and add a multi-iteration report regression test.

findings.title: Split reviews retain only the first part’s usage
findings.description: Each part receives a usage record, but `fold_review_parts()` copies only the first part’s metadata. A verified $1 plus $2 split review reports $1. Because pipeline artifacts are excluded from standalone review statistics, the remaining spend disappears from both views. Aggregate all parts’ usage before persistence.

findings.title: Failed split-review parts violate the folding contract
findings.description: The returned exception result has empty outputs and ordinarily no verdict. The multi-part caller continues and passes it to `fold_review_parts()`, which requires exactly one input file and a verdict per part. Verified reproduction raises `TypeError`, replacing the provider failure and losing captured usage. Stop on failure while preserving accumulated spend, or return a fold-compatible failure result.

findings.title: Failed compaction discards available usage
findings.description: The failure result omits usage even when the provider exception carries telemetry. A successful summary followed by reconnect failure also loses the summary’s spend because `compact()` returns telemetry only after reconnecting. Preserve capture telemetry through both failure paths and test their resulting records.

findings.title: Malformed cost basis crashes the reviews report
findings.description: Set membership raises `TypeError` when valid YAML supplies a list or mapping for `costBasis`. Verified reproduction with `costBasis: [provider]` crashes instead of warning and retaining the row. Validate that the value is a string before membership testing; add list and mapping cases.

Failed split-review parts violate the folding contract
